channel.title: Lynn Group Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: Strong finish pleases O'Connor
item.description: Jack O'Connor feels Kerry have scope for improvement, despite overcoming old rivals Dublin by six points at Croke Park on Saturday night.

item.title: 'You never have them beaten until you're on the bus going home'
item.description: While acknowledging their never-say-die attitude, Peter Queally felt Kilkenny were fortunate to edge out his Waterford side in Division 1A of the Allianz Hurling League courtesy of a controversial late free from Cian Kenny.

item.title: Moran unsurprised by McDonald impact
item.description: Andy Moran wasn't surprised by Kobe McDonald's sensational debut performance for Mayo.

item.title: Corrigan Park to host Antrim v Dublin hurling clash
item.description: Corrigan Park will be called into action again this weekend after it was confirmed as the venue for Antrim's Allianz Hurling League Division 1B Round 5 clash with Dublin.

item.title: O'Callaghan doubtful for Roscommon showdown
item.description: Con O'Callaghan could miss Dublin's Allianz Football League Division 1 clash with Roscommon on Sunday with a hamstring injury.

item.title: 'I've never seen a game go out on such a horrendous pitch'
item.description: Wexford Camogie chairperson Martina Donnellan has hit out at the condition of the pitch for last Saturday's Centra National Camogie League Division 1B clash with Clare.

item.title: Kiely hails Hayes' return
item.description: John Kiely heaped praise on Kyle Hayes after he made a successful return to the Limerick colours last weekend.

item.title: McGeeney vows to stop talking about referees
item.description: Kieran McGeeney has claimed that some journalists are 'infatuated' by him.

item.title: Munster GAA announce championship double headers with camogie and ladies football
item.description: Munster GAA have partnered with Munster Camogie and Munster Ladies Football once again to provide curtain-raisers for some of their Munster SHC and SFC games.

item.title: 'He's the type of superstar Mayo really need'
item.description: Ciarán Whelan has described Kobe McDonald's senior debut for Mayo as 'phenomenal'.
